import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

# Parse the fetch response
feed_data = json.loads(_last_tool_result)
xml_content = feed_data['content']

# Truncate XML at the first incomplete record (if any)
# Find the last complete </entry> tag
last_entry_close = xml_content.rfind('</entry>')
if last_entry_close != -1:
    # Keep content up to and including this closing tag
    xml_content = xml_content[:last_entry_close + len('</entry>')]
    # Add closing </feed> tag
    xml_content += '</feed>'

print(f"Cleaned XML length: {len(xml_content)}")

# Define namespaces used in the Atom feed
ns = {
    'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
    'opensearch': 'http://a9.com/-/spec/opensearch/1.1/',
    'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'
}

# Parse the cleaned XML
root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)

# Collect all <entry> elements
entries = root.findall('.//atom:entry', ns)

papers = []
for entry in entries:
    title_elem = entry.find('atom:title', ns)
    summary_elem = entry.find('atom:summary', ns)
    updated_elem = entry.find('atom:updated', ns)
    
    title = title_elem.text if title_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    summary = summary_elem.text if summary_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    published = updated_elem.text if updated_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    
    authors = []
    for author_elem in entry.findall('.//atom:author', ns):
        name_elem = author_elem.find('atom:name', ns)
        if name_elem is not None:
            authors.append(name_elem.text)
    
    categories = []
    for cat_elem in entry.findall('.//atom:category', ns):
        categories.append(cat_elem.get('term'))
    
    papers.append({
        'title': title,
        'summary': summary,
        'published': published,
        'authors': authors,
        'categories': categories
    })

# Build markdown table
md = "# Multimodal RAG Papers\n\n## Comparison Table\n\n"
md += "| # | Title | Authors | Published | Categories | Summary |\n"
md += "|---|-------|---------|-----------|------------|---------|\n"

for i, p in enumerate(papers, 1):
    title_short = (p['title'][:100] + '...') if len(p['title']) > 100 else p['title']
    authors_short = ', '.join(p['authors'][:5]) if p['authors'] else 'N/A'
    cats_short = ', '.join(p['categories'][:3]) if p['categories'] else 'N/A'
    summary_short = (p['summary'][:200] + '...') if len(p['summary']) > 200 else p['summary']
    md += f"| {i} | {title_short} | {authors_short} | {p['published'][:10]} | {cats_short} | {summary_short} |\n"

# Write markdown file
with open('papers.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(md)

print(f"Created papers.md with {len(papers)} papers")
